name: Christoph Jeffcoat
summary: At Tarren Mill, Christoph Jeffcoat supplies the Forsaken with goods for trade and travel. His wares help crafters and travelers in Hillsbrad Foothills, where the Alliance and the Syndicate contest the land.

sections.title: A Merchant on the Front Lines
sections.body: Christoph Jeffcoat tends to the practical needs of Tarren Mill, the Forsaken stronghold in Hillsbrad Foothills. He sells reagents, tools, threads, and spices to soldiers and traveling artisans. His goods include the spices used in turtle bisque, rare schematics, and alchemical vials. Horde forces passing through southern Lordaeron rely on such supplies as they face Southshore and the dangers of the region.

faq.q: Where can I find Christoph Jeffcoat?
faq.answer: Christoph Jeffcoat is in Tarren Mill, the main Forsaken and Horde stronghold in the northern Hillsbrad Foothills.

faq.q: What kinds of goods does he sell?
faq.answer: He sells tailoring threads, blacksmithing hammers, fluxes, alchemy vials, and cooking spices, including soothing spices and hot spices. He also carries select recipes.

faq.q: Why is he important for local cooks?
faq.answer: Jeffcoat sells Soothing Spices for Soothing Turtle Bisque and teaches the recipe to Horde cooks who bring him turtle meat from the snapjaws.

angles.text: As a cook in Hillsbrad, you can buy Soothing Spices from Christoph Jeffcoat. Bring him snapjaw meat, and he teaches you his Soothing Turtle Bisque recipe.
As a Horde champion campaigning in Hillsbrad Foothills, you can find crafting materials and common tools at Christoph Jeffcoat's shop in Tarren Mill.
